description: Track the xmrig source pin in the Dockerfile: the tag AND the commit it resolved to, in one PR.
The github-tags datasource returns each tag's commit as its digest, so capturing XMRIG_COMMIT as
currentDigest makes Renovate rewrite it alongside XMRIG_VERSION. Neither existing manager does this:
the preset's Dockerfile manager reads only single-line 'ENV *_VERSION=... # datasource/dep' pins, and
the built-in customManagers:dockerfileVersions preset captures currentValue only, so a version-only
bump would leave XMRIG_COMMIT stale and fail the builder stage's rev-parse check. datasource and
depName are templates rather than captures from a comment, because the match string has to stay
within the 120-column .editorconfig limit and JSON has no string concatenation.
Re-enable, and automerge, digest updates for the Dockerfile base image. The preset disables digest
updates for everything except GitHub Actions, which froze the alpine:3.24@sha256 pin while fixed
CVEs accumulated in its packages until Trivy failed every build. Every update still has to pass
verify (build, smoke tests, Trivy) before it merges.
Automerge every xmrig update, majors included. Merging one publishes '<version>-<date>' and moves
'latest' (see the release job in .github/workflows/build.yaml); verify has to pass first.
Dockerfile updates automerge only as a PR, and only once Renovate itself has seen every check pass.
The preset's automergeType 'branch' would merge without CI, because build.yaml does not run on
Renovate branch pushes. platformAutomerge is off because main has no required status checks, so
GitHub-native automerge could merge before verify finishes, or after it fails.
